source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-21

procedures.title: Rear transverse spring: remove, repair and install
steps: Repairs: clamp the spring center section in a vise and remove the center bolt (see figure 53 in the manual).
Open the vise, take the spring out and separate the leaves.
Replace worn or damaged liners and any broken leaves.
To replace main leaf cushion retainers, chisel off the flared part until the retainer can be knocked out of the leaf; put new retainers in and flare them over with a ball-peen hammer or similar tool.
Line up the leaves with a drift through the center bolt holes (see figure 54 in the manual); fit the center bolt and tighten it securely.
Installation: set the spring on the carrier cover mounting face with the center bolt head located in the hole in the cover.
Fit the center clamp plate with its 4 bolts and washers; torque the bolts to specification.
Jack the outer end of the spring until nearly flat and chain it as in removal step 3.
Lower the jack, line the torque control arm up with the spring end, and fit the link bolt, rubber cushions and retainers.
Run the castellated nut on the link bolt until the cotter pin hole shows; fit a new cotter pin and bend its ends around.
Jack up under the link bolt and remove the chain and C-clamp once loose.
Lower the jack slowly, keeping the rubber cushions seated in their retainers.
Remove the jack and repeat on the other side.
Refit wheels and tires, remove the frame supports and lower the car.

procedures.title: Rear torque control arm: remove, repair and install
steps: Disconnect the spring on the side being worked on (Spring Removal steps 1-6).
If fitted, disconnect the stabilizer shaft from the torque arm (see Stabilizer Shaft Replacement).
Take the shock absorber lower eye off the strut rod shaft.
Disconnect and remove the strut rod shaft and swing the strut rod down.
Remove the 4 bolts holding the axle drive shaft to the spindle flange and disconnect the drive shaft.
notes: Figure 55 in the manual shows the pivot bolt, torque arm and toe-in shims; figure 56 is a cross-section of the arm bushing (retainer, retainer plate, bushing).
